argv: env -u GIT_DIR -u GIT_WORK_TREE -u GIT_INDEX_FILE git -C "$C" show "$REV:SKILL.md" > "$W/SKILL.md"; sha256sum "$W/SKILL.md"; wc -l "$W/SKILL.md"; sed -n "883,897p" "$W/SKILL.md" | sha256sum; printf "%s" "$(sed -n "883,897p" "$W/SKILL.md")" | sha256sum; grep -n "^### " "$W/SKILL.md" | sed -n "/^88[0-9]:/p;/^89[0-9]:/p"
